title: Towards Human-AI Deliberation: Design and Evaluation of LLM-Empowered Deliberative AI for AI-Assisted Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper explores the design and human-centric evaluation of an LLM-powered deliberative AI system. Although it includes a discussion section on ethical concerns and fairness in decision-making, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
